name: l2_scn_0701_the_assassination_with_a_political_story_v1
about: L2 scenario seed SCN-0701 (The Assassination With a Political Story) overlaid on an Orion Station watch. An assassin is granted access to a protected leader after presenting a convincing narrative of why the assassination is justified - but the narrative itself may be the real weapon. The seed is a pressure field and initial-condition template: roles, pressure axes, and knobs shape the run; expected end states are observation categories, never required endings. Root fixture only; not canon.
